final_objective.core_goal: Trade frequently enough at FX locations with positive edge, high win rate, acceptable drawdown and robust after-cost expectancy.
final_objective.source_alerts: Mochipoyo source alerts remain a valuable research and coverage reference, but source match itself is not the final promotion objective.
final_objective.extra_alerts: Independent extra trades are welcome when they add robust after-cost value.
final_objective.frequency_tradeoff: Do not maximize win rate by making the rules so strict that trade frequency collapses.
